correctness.rationale: Fresh scalar derivation yields x_next=x(1-a/L(u)); monotone |x| descent for 0<a<=2ln2. ORIGINAL has incorrect unrestricted asymptotic assertions: at critical a=2ln2, u0=ln3 makes x1=0, so t|x_t|->0 and signs do not eventually alternate; at a=ln3, u0=ln2 gives x1=0 and x_next/x_t undefined thereafter. The COMPLETE REPAIRED RESULT explicitly distinguishes terminating/nonterminating orbits. Zero hits iff L(u)=a and nonzero u_hit=ln(exp(a)-1) exists for a>ln2; all nonterminating subcritical and critical asymptotics follow Taylor/reciprocal recurrence; supercritical x*=ln(exp(a/2)-1)/(beta lambda) has |d|<1. Analytical proof covers all parameters in stated memoryless scalar domain.
residual_risks: No theorem for nonzero momentum or arbitrary stochastic/multidimensional implementation; symmetric two-cycle only locally attractive.
